title: Bomb attack in western Colombia kills four, including baby, local official says
paragraphs: At least four people were killed when a lorry laden with explosives detonated in Tolima province, western Colombia, on Sunday, a local official has said.
A two-month-old baby girl was among the dead, Tolima governor Adriana Magali Matiz wrote in a post on X.
The lorry exploded near a military base in the town of Planadas, damaging a nearby hospital and several other buildings.
